description: Before you draft a pitch, asks the server whether the creator may pitch this brand, and every reason they may not: pitching is off in their rules or they haven't added the mailing address every pitch carries, the brand is on their do-not-contact list, there is already an open deal or a waiting inquiry with it, it was pitched in the last 90 days, 10 pitches were drafted in the last 24 hours, the creator declines its category, or a recorded exclusivity rules it out. With contact_email it also checks the address: someone already in the contact book, or a company address at the brand's own domain that found_at, a page on that site, really shows. Never guess or build an address (no firstname@ patterns), never use a lead list, and pitch one person per brand. ok false means don't pitch; tell the creator the reasons.

category.description: What they sell, like 'skincare', checked against what the creator declines and their exclusivities

contact_email.description: A person already in the contact book, or an address the brand publishes on its own site

found_at.description: The https page on the brand's site that shows the address (its contact, press or partnerships page)

partner_id.description: The brand in the contact book (partners_list), when it's there

website.description: The brand's own website; the address has to be at its domain

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: pitch_check
title: Check a brand before pitching
